query: I have a 48‑year‑old man. Among male patients aged 43–53 admitted with ACS and initial hs‑Troponin T >99th percentile (ULN), what are the median and IQR of initial values in ng/mL?
final_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS num_patients,
  ROUND(APPROX_QUANTILES(hs_tnt_ngml, 4)[OFFSET(2)], 4) AS median_ng_per_ml,
  ROUND(APPROX_QUANTILES(hs_tnt_ngml, 4)[OFFSET(1)], 4) AS q1_ng_per_ml,
  ROUND(APPROX_QUANTILES(hs_tnt_ngml, 4)[OFFSET(3)], 4) AS q3_ng_per_ml
FROM above_uln;
